decomposition.scope: Pointwise signed tensors satisfy (field0-field2)=(field0-field1)+(field1-field2). All three differences and their signed cross product are integrated directly on one union of material partitions and the full reference volume/area. The squared total equals the two squared contributions plus twice their cross product; their RMS magnitudes are not additive error budgets. All relative values use the same fine-reference norm, with null relative values at an exactly zero reference and no arbitrary floor. Assigning physical meaning to each difference requires the separately verified field sources and admissions.

scope: Matched250um physical-pad Shell controls at0.1/0.3/1N, q9/q25, exact declared P2 physical volume carrier and independent complete resultant-array cross checks. The same-traction solid is the250um two-wall centroid-pressure source, not a certified fine continuum reference. C-S measures static/history/map differences; S-R pressure-feedback differences; R-F combines Shell elasticity/discretization/transfer. Direct tensor identities hold with measured cross terms; scalar RMS values are not additive. Existing qualified125um normal ranks remain separate.
